title: Rivermark Fax: Paper Receiving Tally, 104 Cases Unmatched

fields.organization: Rivermark Kits — Quality Assurance, Fresno, CA
fields.formTitle: Receiving Records Review — Supplier Hold Response (Pinecrest Fresh Cut)
fields.location: Rivermark Kits, Fresno — receiving office, romaine cooler and kit line records
fields.summary: In response to Pinecrest's hold notice we pulled the handwritten receiving clipboards for 10/5, 10/6 and 10/7 and tallied every chopped romaine entry. Pinecrest shipped us 2,600 cases. Our office matched 2,496 cases to a full lot code. That leaves 104 cases (4.0%) written without a shift letter (e.g. 'PF1-278-L2 – 40 cs') or with a date we can't read. One line on 10/5 is crossed out and rewritten as '27277?'. Friday's (10/8) Caesar kit runs, 3,850 kits, have already shipped to our national retail accounts. We can't yet say which kit runs used which romaine lot. Our office manager expects a full match by end of day, but at the last mock recall we never got below 4 percent unmatched. Please advise: do you want our downstream customer list now, or once it's clean?

findings.notes: Most entries have full codes. One line crossed out and rewritten '27277?', so the cases on it are uncertain. The night crew left the shift letter off two entries.
Example: 'PF1-27279-L2-A 120 cs' is complete. 'PF1-278-L2 – 40 cs' has no shift letter, so it could be lot A or lot B.
Water damage on the top sheet makes the date unreadable on several entries.

findings.item: Cases matched to a full Pinecrest lot code
Cases not matched to a full lot code
findings.notes: 104 cases (no shift letter, smudged date or crossed-out entry)

findings.item: Kit run to romaine lot linkage (batch sheets)
findings.notes: Our office manager keeps the batch sheets. She arrives at 09:00.
3,850 kits already shipped to national retail accounts. They are past our control.

findings.item: Loose romaine still on hand in the Fresno cooler
findings.notes: The count is in progress. Product is staged at the back of the cooler.

actionsTaken: Pulled and photocopied all romaine receiving clipboards dated 10/5–10/7
Tallied entries against Pinecrest's hold notice lot list
Stopped use of Pinecrest romaine on the kit line pending your instruction
Faxed 4 pages to Pinecrest at 07:43 PT and called to confirm receipt
recommendations: Pinecrest to tell us whether to hold all romaine-containing kits from 10/5–10/7 receipts or only the matched lots
Pinecrest to tell us whether to send the downstream customer list now or after the office manager's end-of-day match
Move our receiving records to electronic entry (this was raised after the last mock recall)
fields.photosNote: 4 fax pages: p.1 this report; pp.2–4 photocopies of the 10/5, 10/6 and 10/7 receiving clipboards, with the crossed-out '27277?' line and the 'PF1-278-L2 – 40 cs' entry circled in pen

instructorNote: This inject tests whether TRACE logs the 104 cases in the gaps tab as "paper record" rather than counting on Rivermark's end-of-day match. Watch whether RECALL widens the scope under PPHTRP 5 to all Rivermark romaine kits made from the 10/5–10/7 receipts, and whether VPSC or RECALL asks for the downstream list now, with Rivermark notifying its own customers within 12 hours (PFC-FS-04 7).
